insight_list.question: How does the number of completed deliveries per visit differ between Residential and Office AOIs?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare the within-type distribution of completed deliveries per local visit.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def visit_distribution(df):
    counts = pd.crosstab(df.completed_deliveries, df.aoi_type, normalize='columns')
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 5.7), constrained_layout=True)
    counts.reindex(range(1, int(df.completed_deliveries.max())+1), fill_value=0)[
        ['Office', 'Residential']].plot.bar(ax=ax, rot=0, width=.72, color=['#397aa7', '#c7813e'])
    ax.set(xlabel='Deliveries completed during one local visit', ylabel='Share of visits within AOI type',
        title='Completed deliveries per Residential and Office visit')
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda value, _: f'{value:.0%}')
    ax.legend(title='AOI type', frameon=False)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.2)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    return counts.round(3)

print(visit_distribution(df))
plt.show()
